description: Congressman Ronny Jackson proudly represents Texas’ 13th District, spanning 38 counties and over 40,000 square miles of the Panhandle and North Texas. A retired Navy Rear Admiral, White House Physician to three U.S. Presidents, and Chief Medical Advisor to President Donald J. Trump, Dr. Jackson spent 25 years serving our country with honor. Today, he fights for Texas families on the House Armed Services Committee, House Agriculture Committee, House Foreign Affairs Committee, and the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, defending our national security, supporting our farmers and ranchers, and ensuring America remains strong, free, and prosperous.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Team Ronny, a joint fundraising committee authorized and composed of Texans for Ronny Jackson,Texas Red, and NRCC
